items.summaryEn: Find out what our Gunners have been up to before we take on OL Lyonnes in the UWCL
bodyEn: We face eight-time European champions OL Lyonnes in the UEFA Women's Champions League on Thursday night, and you can find out what we've been up to in training before the tie with our latest training gallery.

Our Gunners battled to a 1-1 draw with Barcelona in Spain last week, ensuring we enter the final two rounds of the league phase in the top four, where we'll need to finish in order to progress to the quarter-finals without the need for a play-off.
OL Lyonnes have been a familiar opponent in the past two seasons, with Thursday's game set to be our eighth meeting in the last four seasons.

items.titleEn: Maanum: “I love the competitive, big games”
items.summaryEn: In-form Frida Maanum is looking forward to Thursday night’s visit of UEFA Women’s Champions League leaders Lyon at Meadow Park.
bodyEn: In-form Frida Maanum is looking forward to Thursday night’s visit of UEFA Women’s Champions League leaders Lyon at Meadow Park.
Our Norwegian forward has been a big part of the last two matches, scoring away to Barcelona at Camp Nou and against London City Lionesses on Sunday.
Now, she can’t wait to do her best to keep that run going.

“I’m not going to lie, the autumn has been quite hard with injuries and stuff, so it's nice to be back, nice to help the team and contribute in my kind of way,” she said in her pre-match press conference on Wednesday. “It's been two good games for me, but obviously we want the wins as well, so that's the most important thing going into the game tomorrow as well.”
Both of her last two goals have been setup by Alessia Russo, who Maanum has an excellent partnership with.

“I love to play with Alessia,” she added. “I’ve said it before, she makes me feel really safe on the pitch. We know each other really well, we've played together for many years now, so she knows what I need and I know what she needs. I think you can see that clicking in the game as well.”
Maanum was also asked about the freedom she’s provided on the pitch by the coaching staff, and how much she’s enjoying her football now.

“I feel really free on the pitch, which is when I feel I'm at my best as well, being able to pick up those second balls and from there, put the players in good positions, which I'm always trying to do,” she explained. “I’ve said it before, but run for the girls.

“I’ve been out for a while, a bit on and off, so yes, I definitely enjoy being out there, try and just put a smile on my face once I'm playing and enjoy it, play with freedom, as I said, and be present in the moment. I think that's the most important thing for me right now.”

Asked what to expect from Lyon’s top talent, Maanum continued: “They've obviously got a lot of quality in their team. We've played against them many times before, but I do love those games. I do love when it's competitive, the big games, two really good teams coming up against each other, so we have to remember the quality we have in the team as well and show that tomorrow.
“The atmosphere [at Meadow Park] is something different, I'd say. It's always special to be there. You feel the crowd pushing us all the way, so we're definitely going to use that energy tomorrow.”

items.titleZh: 马努姆：我热爱竞争激烈的大场面
items.summaryZh: 状态正佳的弗里达·马努姆正期待着周四晚主场迎战欧冠领头羊里昂。
bodyZh: 状态正佳的弗里达·马努姆正期待着周四晚在美度公园球场迎战欧洲女子冠军联赛领头羊里昂。
我们的挪威前锋在最近两场比赛中发挥了重要作用，先是在诺坎普客场对阵巴塞罗那的比赛中破门，周日又在对阵伦敦城狮队的比赛中有进球。
现在，她迫不及待地想竭尽全力延续这一良好状态。
她在周三的赛前新闻发布会上表示：“说实话，这个秋天因为伤病等原因过得相当艰难，所以能够复出、以自己的方式帮助球队并作出贡献感觉很好。对我来说这是两场不错的比赛，但显然我们也渴望胜利，这才是明天比赛最重要的事情。”
她最近的两粒进球都是由阿莱西亚·鲁索助攻的，马努姆与她有着极佳的默契。
她补充道：“我喜欢和阿莱西亚一起踢球。我以前说过，她在球场上让我感到非常安心。我们非常了解彼此，已经一起踢球很多年了，所以她知道我需要什么，我也知道她需要什么。我想你在比赛中也能看到这种默契。”
马努姆还被问及教练组赋予她在场上的自由度，以及她现在有多么享受足球。
她解释道：“我在球场上感到非常自由，这也是我觉得自己状态最好的时候，能够抢到这些二落球，并从那里把球传给处于好位置的球员，我一直在努力这样做。我以前说过，就是为队友们奔跑。”
“我缺阵了一段时间，有些断断续续，所以是的，我非常享受在场上的时光，踢球时尽量面带微笑去享受它，带着自由去踢球，正如我所说，活在当下。我想这对我目前来说是最重要的事。”
当被问及对里昂顶尖才华有何期待时，马努姆继续说道：“她们阵中显然有很多优秀球员。我们以前和她们交手过很多次，但我确实很喜欢这些比赛。我喜欢竞争激烈的大场面，两支真正出色的球队交锋，所以我们也必须记住我们球队自身的实力，并在明天展现出来。”
“美度公园球场的氛围可以说是与众不同。在那里总是很特别。你能感受到球迷一路在推动我们前进，所以我们明天一定会利用好这股能量。”

items.titleEn: Renée: “Meadow Park is a special ground for us”
items.summaryEn: The head coach on the atmosphere we can create in Thursday's UEFA Women's Champions League clash with Lyon
bodyEn: A Thursday night under the lights at Meadow Park in Borehamwood awaits us for this week’s UEFA Women’s Champions League encounter with table-toppers Lyon.
We’ve enjoyed our two home matches in the competition so far, having beaten HB Koge 1-0 and Benfica 3-0, so here’s hoping for more of the same against the French champions.

In her pre-match press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Wednesday, Renée Slegers said: “I think the closeness, the closeness to the people [at Meadow Park], you feel that, you feel the energy in the stands.

“You can almost hear what they say and you feel that connection even more. I like that about playing at Meadow Park. The challenge is that it's all very open and close to the opposition, so it’s up to us to find a code language down the sideline maybe!

“No, we love going there and it's a special ground for Arsenal Women. That's where it all started, so it is special that we're still playing there. Of course, in combination with the Emirates, which really feels like our home as well.”

Our last game at Emirates Stadium ended in a 1-1 draw against London City Lionesses on Sunday, so what can we take from that match, as well last week’s trip to Barcelona, ahead of this game with Lyon?

“They are three different teams, so Barcelona work with very close relationships, close connections on the pitch, London City was a little different in that sense, but there were similarities,” Renée explained. “What they do similarly is very high and aggressive pressure, jump pressure.

“Lyon are a very athletic team as well, they have a lot of fast players, so we’ll have to manage that really well and defend that really well, and make sure that we’re in good areas on the pitch and have numbers around the ball. It will be a different game, it’s also a different pitch.

“So what we’ll do to turn that into a win is do our very best to put a good plan together that the players are going to execute. This game is different in that sense, I think we’ll have to manage their speed in this game and look at our chances as well.”

Asked whether we’ll try to prioritise not conceding against a Lyon side who have scored 20 goals in Europe this season, or finding the back of the net against a team who are yet to concede, Renée continued: “It goes hand-in-hand, we played against Barcelona and I think at that point they had scored 19 as well and conceded two, so very similar scenario in that sense, but two different types of teams.

“What we’ll have to do is we want to play our game, the last two games we’ve spent less time on the ball. Our ambition is to spend more time on the ball tomorrow, that helps us defend as well because if you’re on the ball, you’re automatically not defending, so that’s important for us tomorrow. But also a huge respect for the team they are, the qualities that they possess and the game that they’re going to bring to us. We’ve played against them a lot lately in the last two years, so a huge respect for what they’ve achieved so far, and we’ll look forward to the game tomorrow.”

items.titleZh: 雷妮：美 Meadow Park 对我们而言是座特殊的球场
items.summaryZh: 主帅雷妮展望周四欧冠对阵里昂的比赛。
bodyZh: 本周四晚，我们将前往博勒姆伍德的美多公园球场（Meadow Park），在灯光下迎来欧冠小组赛对阵领头羊里昂的比赛。
我们在本届欧冠的前两个主场比赛中表现出色，分别以1-0击败克厄、3-0战胜本菲卡，因此我们希望对阵这支法国冠军球队时能延续好运。
在周三于索巴地产训练基地举行的赛前新闻发布会上，雷妮·斯勒格斯表示：“我认为美多公园球场的这种紧凑感，与球迷之间的近距离接触，你能真切感受到看台上的能量。”
“你甚至能听到他们的声音，并感受到更深层次的联系。我很喜欢在美多公园球场比赛。但挑战在于这里非常开阔且紧凑，离对手也很近，所以也许我们需要在边线附近找到某种暗号语言！”
“不，我们真的很喜欢去那里，这对阿森纳女足来说是一座特殊的球场。一切都是从那里开始的，所以我们现在仍然在那里比赛，感觉非常特殊。当然，这也结合了酋长球场，那里同样真正让我们感觉像家一样。”
我们上周日在酋长球场的上一场比赛中以1-1战平伦敦城雌狮，那么在迎战里昂之前，我们可以从那场比赛以及上周客场对阵巴塞罗那的比赛中汲取什么经验呢？
雷妮解释说：“这是三支不同的球队，巴塞罗那在球场上有着非常紧密的联系，伦敦城在这方面略有不同，但也有相似之处。它们的相似之处在于都拥有非常高压和极具侵略性的前压。”
“里昂也是一支非常具有运动能力的球队，她们拥有很多速度极快的球员，所以我们必须很好地应对和防守，确保我们占据球场上的好位置，并在球的周围形成人数优势。这将是一场不同的比赛，球场也不同。”
“因此，为了将比赛转化为胜利，我们将尽最大努力制定出一套出色的战术计划并由球员去执行。从这个意义上说，这场比赛有所不同，我认为我们必须在这场比赛中限制她们的速度，同时寻找我们的机会。”
当被问及面对本赛季在欧洲赛场打进20球且一球未失的里昂，球队是会优先考虑不失球，还是力争打破对手的不失球金身时，雷妮接着说道：“这两者是相辅相成的。我们之前对阵过巴塞罗那，当时她们也打进了19球且仅失2球，情况非常相似，但这是两种不同类型的球队。”
“我们要做的就是打出我们的比赛，过去两场比赛我们在控球上花的时间较少。我们的目标是明天能在控球上花更多时间，这也有助于防守，因为只要你控球，你就自然不用防守，这对我们明天的比赛很重要。但同时，我们也对这支球队、她们具备的品质以及她们将带给我们的比赛抱有极大的尊重。我们在过去两年里经常与她们交手，因此对她们迄今为止取得的成就致以崇高的敬意，我们非常期待明天的比赛。”

Our head coach sat down to look ahead to Thursday's UEFA Women's Champions League clash at Meadow Park.
Here's everything she had to say on the following subjects...

on what we can take from the Barcelona and London City games to prepare for Lyon:They are three different teams, so Barcelona work with very close relationships, close connections on the pitch, London City was a little different in that sense, but there were similarities. This game is different in that sense, I think we’ll have to manage their speed in this game and look at our chances as well.

on if we will prioritise not conceding or scoring goals against Lyon:It goes hand-in-hand, we played against Barcelona and I think at that point they had scored 19 as well and conceded two, so very similar scenario in that sense, but two different types of teams. What we’ll have to do is we want to play our game, the last two games we’ve spent less time on the ball. We’ve played against them a lot lately in the last two years, so a huge respect for what they’ve achieved so far, and we’ll look forward to the game tomorrow.

on if we’ve been working on set-pieces ahead of a game against a physical side:Yes, we're working on our set-pieces. We know it's an important area for us. We create a lot of corners. If I go into corners specifically, it's something we want to do better. Also, when it doesn't happen in open play, there's always the set-piece. That's something we're working on definitely for tomorrow. It's of course the defending set-pieces as well, with the threat that they have, which is important in the game plan. We'll have to look at what we can create against them because we won't be taller than Wendie Renard, so we'll have to find other solutions and ideas.

on if Sunday’s match was an exciting advert for women’s football:Very good game of football. Especially the first half, I think maybe you saw some fatigue coming into the second half, end of the second half, but the first half was fantastic football and we scored a great goal early in the game. We are front-footed, intense, and find solutions fast in moments. So, no, really good football, which is great. I think many people talk about it, the WSL being the best league potentially in the world right now. I think if you look at that game, for example, it was a really good game of football, which is important. That's the product that we want to deliver, but for us, of course, with the draws that we've had, we needed and wanted to convert that into three points, which we didn't do on Sunday.

on if we’re expecting an open, unpredictable match against Lyon:We have to accept that it's open at times with the way they play, but our preference is that it's not too open. We want to control it, we want to control spaces, we want to control the game a little bit better, spend time on the ball, but then we also know that when there are spaces given and opportunities, we are good when things go fast, so we'll have to be really good dictating tempo and choosing what to do when in the game.

on what it’s like to have Maanum back:Yeah, great. We just spoke about the freedom on the pitch, and I'm happy you feel that way. I think one of Frida's qualities as well is positional intelligence and discipline as well, so that balance and those two things that Frida can bring both to the game is fantastic and helps the team, makes other players better around her. And now, also at the end of two chances, it's really good to have Frida back and it means a lot to us. Two 90s after a while out, so really good physically as well, so now really happy to have Frida back.

on how the atmosphere at Meadow Park helps the team:I think the closeness, the closeness to the people. You feel that, you feel the energy in the stands. You can almost hear what they say and you feel that connection even more. I like that about playing at Meadow Park. The challenge is that it's all very open and close to the opposition, so for us to find a code language down the sideline, maybe. No, we love going there and it's a special ground for Arsenal Women. That's where it all started, so it is special that we're still playing there. Of course, in combination with the Emirates, which really feels like our home as well.

items.titleZh: 雷妮赛前新闻发布会全文
items.summaryZh: 主教练雷妮出席欧冠对阵里昂赛前新闻发布会。
bodyZh: 周三，雷妮·斯勒格斯在索布哈地产训练中心出席了对阵里昂的赛前新闻发布会。
我们的主教练坐下来，展望了周四在梅多公园球场进行的欧洲女足冠军联赛较量。
以下是她就以下话题所说的一切……

关于我们可以从对阵巴塞罗那和伦敦城的比赛中借鉴什么来备战里昂：它们是三支不同的球队，巴塞罗那在球场上有非常紧密的联系和配合，伦敦城在某种意义上略有不同，但也有相似之处。它们的相似之处在于非常高且具有侵略性的压迫。里昂也是一支极具身体素质的球队，她们拥有许多速度极快的球员，所以我们必须很好地应对和防守，确保我们处在球场的好位置，并在球周围形成人数优势。这将是一场不同的比赛，场地也不同。因此，我们要做的就是尽最大努力制定一个让球员们去执行的好计划，从而将之转化为胜利。从这个意义上说，这场比赛有所不同，我认为我们必须在这场比赛中控制她们的速度，并寻找我们的机会。

关于我们是否会优先考虑对阵里昂时不失球还是进球：这两者是相辅相成的。我们对阵过巴塞罗那，当时她们也进了19球丢了2球，从这个意义上说情况非常相似，但两支球队类型不同。我们要做的就是打出我们的风格，过去两场比赛我们控球时间较少。我们的目标是明天能有更多控球时间，这也有助于防守，因为如果你在控球，你就自然不用防守，这对我们明天的比赛很重要。但同时，我们也对这支球队、她们拥有的实力以及她们将带给我们的比赛抱有极大的敬意。在过去的两年里，我们最近经常与她们交手，因此我们对她们迄今为止取得的成就致以崇高的敬意，并期待着明天的比赛。

关于在面对一支身体对抗出色的球队时，我们是否一直在演练定位球：是的，我们正在演练定位球。我们知道这是我们的一大重点区域。我们创造了很多角球。具体到角球，这是我们想要做得更好的地方。此外，当运动战打不开局面时，总还有定位球。这绝对是我们为明天一直在做的工作。当然，考虑到她们的威胁，防守定位球也很重要，这是比赛计划中的关键部分。我们必须看看我们能对她们创造出什么，因为我们在身高上不可能超过温迪·勒纳尔，所以我们必须寻找其他解决方案和思路。

关于周日的比赛是否是对女子足球的一次精彩宣传：这是一场非常精彩的足球比赛。特别是上半场，我想你可能会看到下半场出现了一些疲劳，下半场快结束时也是如此，但上半场踢出了梦幻般的足球，我们在比赛早期就打进了一个精彩的进球。我们敢于压迫、极具强度，并且能在瞬间快速找到解决方案。所以，这是一场非常精彩的足球，这太棒了。我想很多人都在讨论WSL可能是目前世界上最好的联赛。如果你看看那场比赛，它确实是一场非常精彩的足球比赛，这很重要。这就是我们想要呈现的产品，但对我们来说，当然，结合我们之前的平局，我们需要也想要将之转化为三分，但在周日我们没有做到这一点。
关于我们是否期待与里昂进行一场开放且不可预测的比赛：鉴于她们的踢球方式，我们必须接受比赛有时会是开放的，但我们的首选是不要太开放。我们想要掌控比赛，掌控空间，更好地控制比赛，增加控球时间，但我们也知道，当出现空间和机会时，我们在节奏快时表现很好，所以我们必须非常出色地掌控节奏，并在比赛中选择何时做什么。
关于玛娜姆回归的感觉：是的，太棒了。我们刚刚谈到了球场上的自由度，我很高兴你有这种感觉。我认为弗里达的优点之一是战术意识和纪律性，弗里达带给比赛的这种平衡和这两种特质是极好的，它能够帮助球队，让身边的队友变得更好。现在，在经历两次机会后，弗里达的回归真的很好，这对我们意义重大。在缺席一段时间后连续踢了两场90分钟的比赛，所以她的身体状态也非常好，现在我们真的很高兴弗里达能够回归。

关于梅多公园球场的氛围如何帮助球队：我认为是这种亲近感，与人们的亲近感。你能感受到这一点，能感受到看台上的能量。你几乎能听到她们在说些什么，这让你感受到更深的连结。我很喜欢在梅多公园球场踢球。挑战在于这里非常开放，并且离对手很近，所以也许我们需要在边线附近找到一套暗号语言。不，我们喜欢去那里，这里对阿森纳女足来说是一块特殊的场地。一切都是从那里开始的，所以我们仍然在那里踢球非常特殊。当然，这与酋长球场结合在一起，酋长球场也真正让我们感觉像是家一样。

items.titleEn: All the stats from our 300 Premier League away wins
items.summaryEn: We reached 300 away wins in the Premier League by beating Liverpool, and we crunched those numbers to uncover some interesting stats
bodyEn: We’re back on the road this weekend for our longest domestic trip of the season to Newcastle United’s St James’ Park, but we'll do so having already won four of our five Premier League away days this term.
And the last of those, our 1-0 success at Liverpool at the start of the month, saw us reach 300 away wins in the division:
WHERE WE RANK
Our away Premier League record

Interestingly, our win percentage across our entire history was 29.7% before the Premier League’s creation in 1992, whereas it is 45.7% in the new division over the past 34 years, thanks to those three centuries' worth of wins.
Only Manchester United have recorded more away wins than us in the competition’s history, while the Red Devils and Liverpool have scored more times on their travels.
Best away records in Premier League history
GROUNDS AND OPPONENTS

We have visited 60 different stadia on our travels in that time, and statistically, trips to our joint-favourite venues have brought more joy in recent months. The victory that wrapped up our 2025/26 Premier League title success at Selhurst Park was our 16th at that ground, while the 1-0 win at Villa Park in August matched that tally.
Away stadiums we’ve won most PL games at

However with both Crystal Palace and Wimbledon sharing the south London venue, West Ham United are actually the opponents we have beaten most and taken the most away points off on our Premier League travels, with 17 victories from 30 visits to Upton Park and the London Stadium.
One of those includes our joint-biggest win on our travels, the 6-0 demolition in February 2024, matched three weeks later when we recorded the same scoreline at Sheffield United’s Bramall Lane.
Best away records against PL opponents
Our best 100% record at a venue is at Hull City’s MKM Stadium where we have won on all five visits, and will get the chance to extend that record in January following the Tigers’ top-flight return.

Out of the 60 stadia visited, we won matches at 55. We’ll never have the chance to add Bolton’s Burnden Park, Roker Park in Sunderland or Middlesbrough’s Ayresome Park to our list, where we lost on our only appearance, but should Bradford City return to the top-flight, we’d head to Valley Parade aiming for three points at the third attempt. We also failed to win twice at Wembley Stadium when Tottenham were tenants.
GOALS
We’ve enjoyed a much better record at their new Tottenham Hotspur Stadium home, winning four of the seven games we’ve contested there, compared with five wins in 25 derbies at White Hart Lane.

Victor Gyokeres’ injury-time strike to seal our 4-1 win there in February was the 1,000th goal we scored on the road in the Premier League. Unsurprisingly, Thierry Henry leads the way with the most away goals scored for us in the competition, with 55 of his record-breaking 226 goals coming in away league outings.
Our top scorers in PL away games
MANAGERS

Given he was in charge for 63% of our Premier League away days, Arsène Wenger is the manager who has brought the most three-point hauls back to N5, but Mikel Arteta is also racking them up at a record rate.

Our current boss boasts the best win percentage of any of our permanent managers in the division, winning 70 of his 129 road games so far, and is the only man to have won more than one in every two away games:
Arsenal managers’ PL away records

items.titleZh: 阿森纳英超客场300胜数据盘点
items.summaryZh: 击败利物浦后阿森纳达成英超客场300胜，我们盘点了这些数据背后的精彩统计。
bodyZh: 本周末我们将迎来本赛季国内客场旅程最远的一场比赛，前往纽卡斯尔联队的主场圣詹姆斯公园球场，而在此之前，我们在本赛季已进行的五场英超客场比赛中赢下了四场。
而其中的最后一场，即本月初在客场1-0战胜利物浦的比赛，让我们在英超联赛中的客场胜利达到了300场：
我们的排名
我们在英超联赛中的客场战绩
有趣的是，在1992年英超成立之前，我们整个历史上的客场胜率为29.7%，而在过去34年的新联赛中，由于这300场胜利，这一数字达到了45.7%。
在该赛事历史上，只有曼联的客场胜场数比我们多，同时曼联和利物浦在客场的进球数也比我们多。
英超历史上的最佳客场战绩
球场与对手
在此期间，我们的客场足迹遍布60座不同的球场。从统计数据来看，最近几个月造访我们并列最喜欢的球场带来了更多的欢乐。我们在塞尔赫斯特公园球场锁定2025/26赛季英超冠军的胜利，是我们在这座球场的第16场胜利，而8月份在维拉公园球场1-0的胜利也达到了这一数字。
我们赢得英超客场比赛最多的球场
然而，由于水晶宫和温布尔登共用这座南伦敦球场，西汉姆联实际上是我们英超客场之旅中击败次数最多、拿到客场积分最多的对手。在我们30次造访厄普顿公园和伦敦体育场期间，我们取得了17场胜利。
其中一场胜利包括我们在客场并列最大比分的赢球，即2024年2月以6-0大胜，三周后我们在谢菲尔德联队的布拉莫尔巷球场再次打出了同样的比分。
对阵英超对手的最佳客场战绩
我们在某座球场保持100%胜率的最佳纪录是在赫尔城队的MKM体育场，我们在五次造访中全部取胜，并且随着这只老虎队重返顶级联赛，我们将在明年1月获得扩大这一纪录的机会。
在我们造访过的60座球场中，我们在55座球场赢过比赛。我们再也没有机会将博尔顿的伯登公园球场、桑德兰的罗克尔公园球场或米德尔斯堡的艾索姆公园球场加入我们的名单，我们在那里仅有的一场比赛中均告失利；但如果布拉德福德城重返顶级联赛，我们将第三次向谷地 parade 发起冲击并全取三分。当托特纳姆热刺租用温布利球场时，我们也在那里两次未能取胜。
进球
我们在他们的新主场托特纳姆热刺球场战绩要好得多，在我们那里的七场比赛中赢了四场，相比之下，我们在白鹿巷球场的25场德比中只赢了五场。
维克托·哲凯赖什在2月份的比赛中补时绝杀，帮助我们4-1取胜，这也是我们在英超联赛中打入的第1000个客场进球。毫不意外的是，蒂埃里·亨利在俱乐部该赛事的客场进球榜上领跑，他创纪录的226个进球中有55个来自于客场联赛。
我们在英超客场比赛中的最佳射手
主教练
鉴于温格执教了我们63%的英超客场比赛，他是为N5带回最多三分的主教练，但米克尔·阿尔特塔也正以创纪录的速度积累胜场。
我们的现任主帅在英超所有正式主教练中保持着最佳胜率，他在迄今为止的129场客场比赛中赢了70场，并且是唯一一位客场胜率超过二分之一的主教练：

items.titleEn: Dowman and Donczew star in youth internationals
items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners enjoyed a successful international break with several progressing to the next round of Euro qualifying
bodyEn: Max Dowman scored a late winner for England under-21s against France on just his second appearance for the young lions.
Having come off the bench for his under-21s debut three days earlier in a 1-0 defeat to Portugal, Dowman made his full debut at Ashton Gate, and ended it in style.

After starting the break with a defeat, England looked to be on course for a comfortable win over Les Blues as on-loan Gunners Ethan Nwaneri, who provided two assists, and Tommy Setford, who made a number of crucial saves, saw the young Lions take a 2-0 lead into the final ten minutes.
But France struck back in the later stages, pulling it back to 2-2, only for Dowman to arrive in the right place at the right time in the 89th-minute to net a close-range winner.

Marli Salmon also enjoyed a successful break with England at under-19s level. Our central defender started the first two games of the international window for Ben Futcher's side, as they beat Slovenia 4-1 and Belarus 5-0 in Austria.

While a 4-1 defeat to Austria, for which Salmon was an unused substitute, prevented a perfect three wins from three, the young Lions still advanced to the next round of U19 European Championship qualifying.

At under-17s level, our young strikers Mylo Bernard and Vincent Joseph were both involved in three U17 Euro qualifiers. Joseph started each of the first two games, which saw his side beat Montenegro 6-1 and Poland 2-0.

Bernard, having come off the bench in place of Joseph in each of the first two games in the mini-tournament, started the third game against Ukraine, and made the most of the opportunity, netting the final goal in a comfortable 3-0 win which saw England through to the next round.
Away from the England teams, Callan Hamill's Scotland won two out of three games in an under-19s qualifying group with Kazakhstan, Kosovo and Belgium.

Hosts Scotland started with a comfortable 3-1 win over Kazakhstan, before battling to a 1-0 success against Kosovo. While the break ended with a 4-1 defeat to Belgium, Callan's side still progressed to the next round of U19 Euro qualifying with six points.

Northern Ireland U17s will continue in U17 Euro qualifying, but will do so in League B after two defeats in three games in Frankfurt. Daniel McCarron captained his side in all three matches, playing every minute during the window, which started with a 4-2 defeat to Lithuania, despite McCarron's side leading 2-0 in the early stages.
Fortunes looked to be turning for Northern Ireland as they thrashed Azerbaijan 4-0, but a defeat to hosts Germany by the same scoreline saw them finish third in the four-team group.

Axel Donczew had a highly productive week with two assists in three starts for Wales under-17s. After a 2-0 defeat to Denmark, the young Red Dragons got back on track with a 2-0 win over the Republic of Ireland. Starting out wide in the third and final game of the break for his country, Axel set up both Wales goals as they twice came from behind to draw 2-2 with Estonia in U17 Euro qualifying.

Patrick Stachow had a near-perfect international break with Poland under-18s, as his side faced Czechia twice in a double-header. Our centre-back helped his side to back-to-back wins and clean sheets, with 1-0 and 3-0 successes in the space of four days.

With the final international break of 2026 behind our young Gunners, attention returns to Academy action. Our under-18s face Chelsea in a London derby which gives us the opportunity to overtake the league leaders with a victory, before our under-19s host Borussia Dortmund in the UEFA Youth League on Tuesday afternoon.

items.titleZh: 道曼与东切夫在青年国家队赛事中闪耀
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳年轻小将在国际比赛日表现出色，多人晋级欧预赛下一阶段。
bodyZh: 在代表英格兰U21对阵法国的比赛中，马克斯·道曼仅迎来个人第二次青年队出场就打入了绝杀进球。
三天前在对阵葡萄牙的比赛中替补登场完成U21首秀并以0-1落败后，道曼在阿什顿门球场迎来了首次先发，并以完美的方式结束了比赛。
在以一场失利开启国际比赛日后，英格兰本有望轻松击败法国队。在阿森纳租借在外的恩瓦内里贡献了两次助攻，汤米·塞特福德做出多次关键扑救，帮助年轻的三狮军团带着2-0的领先优势进入最后十分钟。
但法国队在后半段发起反击将比分扳为2-2，好在道曼在第89分钟出现在正确的位置，近距离破门完成绝杀。
马利·萨尔蒙在英格兰U19的比赛中也度过了一个成功的国际比赛日。这位中后卫在奥地利举行的比赛中首发出战了本菲特彻球队的前两场比赛，帮助球队分别以4-1击败斯洛文尼亚和5-0击败白俄罗斯。
尽管以1-4不敌奥地利的比赛中萨尔蒙未获出场机会，未能取得三战全胜的完美战绩，但年轻的三狮军团依然晋级了U19欧洲杯预选赛的下一阶段。
在U17级别，我们的年轻前锋迈洛·伯纳德和文森特·约瑟夫都参加了三场U17欧预赛。约瑟夫在前两场比赛中均首发出场，帮助球队以6-1击败黑山、2-0击败波兰。
在这项小型锦标赛的前两场比赛中均替补约瑟夫登场的伯纳德，在对阵乌克兰的第三场比赛中首发登场，并充分把握了机会，打入了全场比赛的最后一粒进球，帮助英格兰以3-0轻松取胜并晋级下一阶段。
除了英格兰队外，卡兰·哈米尔效力的苏格兰队在与哈萨克斯坦、科索沃和比利时的U19预选赛小组赛中三战两胜。
作为东道主的苏格兰队先是以3-1轻松击败哈萨克斯坦，随后以1-0险胜科索沃。尽管以1-4不敌比利时结束了本次假期，但卡兰的球队仍以六个积分晋级U19欧预赛下一阶段。
北爱尔兰U17将继续参加U17欧预赛，但在法兰克福的三场比赛遭遇两场失利后，他们将降入B级联赛。丹尼尔·麦卡伦在全部三场比赛中担任队长并打满全场，球队虽然在对阵立陶宛的比赛中开局取得2-0领先，但最终以2-4告负。
北爱尔兰随后以4-0大胜阿塞拜疆，形势似乎有所好转，但以同样比分输给东道主德国后，他们在四支球队的小组中排名第三。
阿克塞尔·东切夫在威尔士U17的三次首发中贡献两次助攻，度过了一个高效的星期。在以0-2不敌丹麦后，年轻的红龙军团以2-0击败爱尔兰共和国重回正轨。在国家队假期第三场也是最后一场比赛中司职边锋的阿克塞尔送出两次助攻，帮助威尔士两度落后两度扳平，以2-2战平爱尔兰，完成U17欧预赛征程。
帕特里克·斯塔霍夫随波兰U18度过了近乎完美的国际比赛日，他的球队在两场背靠背的比赛中对阵捷克。我们的中后卫在四天内连续零封对手并取得两连胜，比分分别为1-0和3-0。
随着2026年最后一次国际比赛日的结束，注意力重新回到了学院的比赛中。我们的U18将在一场伦敦德比中迎战切尔西，取胜即可超越领头羊；随后我们的U19将于周二下午在欧洲青年联赛中主场迎战多特蒙德。

items.titleEn: Odegaard inspires Norway fightback
items.summaryEn: Martin Odegaard and Bruno Guimaraes captained their nations to victories in the final night of international duty
bodyEn: Martin Odegaard delivered a captain's performance to help Norway come from 2-0 down to beat Denmark 3-2 and book a spot in the Nations League quarter-finals.
After falling two goals down, Odegaard chased down goalkeeper Mads Hermansen, forcing the ball into the path of Erling Haaland, who tapped home.
Heading into the final 10 minutes and needing a win to qualify for the last eight, Odegaard fired in an equaliser before Haaland smashed in a stoppage-time penalty to turn things around.
Our skipper then led the celebrations, banging the drum in front of the travelling support as they performed their famous row celebration that was seen over and over again at last summer's World Cup.
Viktor Gyokeres' scoring run may have ended for Sweden, but he did provide an assist in a 1-1 draw with Poland in Warsaw.
After falling behind, Viktor set up Hugo Larsson to equalise as Sweden rounded off their campaign undefeated and secured back-to-back promotions.
Over in Asia, Bruno Guimaraes captained Brazil for the first time as his country ran out 7-0 winners versus Singapore.
After producing two assists in their 3-2 defeat against Japan, Bruno dished out another assist for Vinicius Jr. to get the scoring going at the National Stadium.
Gabriel Magalhaes was also starting his second game in a row and he also provided an assist for Chelsea's Estevao in the second half after Vinicius had already completed his hat-trick.
Endrick, Rayan and an own goal rounded off the scoring as Gabi came off after 60 minutes and Bruno did the same a minute later.
Piero Hincapie rounded off the international window by playing 64 minutes in a 2-0 victory over Bolivia in Quito.

items.titleZh: 厄德高率领挪威完成逆转
items.summaryZh: 厄德高和吉马良斯在国家队比赛日最后一晚率队取胜。
bodyZh: 厄德高奉献了队长级的表现，帮助挪威在两球落后的情况下以3比2逆转击败丹麦，锁定欧国联八强席位。
在连丢两球后，厄德高逼抢门将马德斯·赫尔曼森，将球挡到埃林·哈兰德脚前，后者轻松推射破门。
比赛进入最后10分钟，挪威需要一场胜利来晋级八强，厄德高抽射扳平比分，随后哈兰德在补时阶段罚入点球完成逆转。
我们的队长随后引领了庆祝活动，在客场球迷面前敲起大鼓，球迷们则跳起了去年夏天世界杯上常见的那段标志性划船庆祝动作。
维克托·哲凯赖什在瑞典队的连续进球纪录虽然终结，但他在华沙对阵波兰的比赛中送出了一次助攻，帮助球队1比1战平。
在落后之后，维克托助攻于戈·拉松扳平比分，瑞典队以不败战绩结束了本届赛事并实现连续升班。
在亚洲，布鲁诺·吉马良斯首次担任巴西队队长，帮助球队以7比0大胜新加坡。
在对阵日本的比赛中送出两次助攻后，布鲁诺再次助攻维尼修斯，在国家体育场为球队首开纪录。
加布里埃尔·加尔马良斯同样迎来了连续第二场首发，他在下半场助攻切尔西的埃斯特旺破门，此时维尼修斯已经完成了帽子戏法。
恩德里克、拉扬以及一个乌龙球锁定胜局，加比在第60分钟被换下，布鲁诺在一分钟后也被替换下场。
皮耶罗·因卡皮耶在基多以2比0击败玻利维亚的比赛中出场64分钟，为国家队比赛日画上句号。

bodyEn: Overlapping. Underlapping. Inverted. Traditional. The role of full-back has evolved dramatically. Once a defensive-first position that provided some auxiliary attacking support, the role has developed into something far more multifaceted.

Just ask right-back Ben White, who – with Riccardo Calafiori on the left – has been an important figure in Arsenal’s superb start to the campaign. Talking a few years ago, he said: “Playing full-back the way [Mikel Arteta] wants is completely different to any other manager. To play full-back for him, you’ve got to be a centre-midfielder, a centre-back, a winger and a No 10.”

Between them, White and Calafiori have contributed to six goals for Arsenal already in the Premier League this season (White: three assists; Calafiori: one goal, two assists). No other defender has registered more than three goal involvements so far. The Arsenal duo are a great illustration of the impact full-backs can have. But, with the position more demanding than ever before, how does each Premier League team deploy theirs?

The graphic below shows the average height and width of the touches of each Premier League team’s full-backs, sorted from highest average position to lowest. The most obvious takeaway is that Arsenal’s full-backs have the highest average touch location of any Premier League side this season, coming 58.2 metres from their own goal.

That is a reflection not only of Arsenal’s territorial dominance, but also the license White and Calafiori are given to push into the attacking line. White averages 3.4 touches in the opposition box per 90 minutes, the most of any full-back or wing-back in the division. Calafiori ranks third, with 2.9.

Arsenal’s full-backs also have the narrowest average touch locations of any team, emphasising how far they have moved away from the traditional full-back role of maintaining width. Instead, they are encouraged to drift inside and operate in central areas.

Tottenham also deploy their full-backs extremely high up the pitch. For most of the campaign, that has been Archie Gray at right-back and Andy Robertson on the left. Of course, analysing a player’s influence is not limited to what they do on the ball. Thanks to Opta Vision, we can also track what they do without it.

Gray is particularly noteworthy, given his exceptional work rate. He ranks first among Premier League full-backs for underlapping runs, both in total (23) and per 90 minutes (2.9), and also ranks fourth for overlapping runs per 90 (1.8). That shows the benefit of deploying an attack-minded player at full-back, with Gray showing energy and an ability to get beyond the ball and offer another option in the final third.

Robertson is no slouch on the opposite flank, either. The 32-year-old ranks seventh for underlapping runs per 90 minutes (1.4) and sits inside the top 20 for overlapping runs per 90 (1.1). He has also received more passes ending in the final third (159) than any other full-back.

It might be more of a surprise to see Coventry’s full-backs play so high, given they have not dominated the ball at all (39.1% possession, second-lowest) and they start their attacks from deep (40.2m away from goal, sixth-lowest). It is, however, something they did to good effect in the Championship last season (average height of 56.8m, sixth-highest).

Frank Lampard has also used a back five at times, which means his wing-backs naturally play higher up, but he has been brave with pushing his defensive line up in general. Coventry have provoked the second-most offsides of any team so far (30).
That has allowed Milan van Ewijk and Jay Dasilva to push forward on the flanks. The pair have each created eight chances, with only Jack Rudoni (12) creating more for the Sky Blues.

Dasilva is a particularly important outlet down the left. He takes his touches higher up the pitch than any other full-back in the division, and Coventry have created 42.2% of their open-play chances down his side, the highest proportion of any Premier League team.

It makes sense that Nottingham Forest and Leeds also see their full-backs touch the ball high up the pitch, given they are two of the biggest users of wing-backs. That pair are two of just four teams that predominantly play with wing-backs, with the back three/five becoming a rare breed in the modern Premier League.

For Leeds, Jayden Bogle has been particularly influential going forwards. He has made more runs ending in the opposition box than any other full-back this season. They’ve come at an average of 3.9 per 90 minutes, the second-highest rate in the division, behind only Nico O’Reilly, who has played just 54.3% of his minutes at full-back.

Crystal Palace, meanwhile, are feeling the effects of losing the influential Daniel Muñoz. Despite playing solely with wing-backs, they have gone from having the highest average full-back positioning in the Premier League in 2025-26 to sitting below the league average this season. Muñoz was relentless in his work up and down the right flank last term, and his absence has clearly affected the extent to which Palace are able to push their right-sided wing-back up in those wide areas.

The Colombian is now at Nottingham Forest with his former manager Oliver Glasner. They have gone from having the fifth-lowest average touch location for their full-backs to the fourth-highest. That is not only down to Muñoz, but having someone who is able to put in consistent lung-busting runs – he is behind only Ipswich Town’s Leif Davis for the average length of his off-ball runs – helps a lot.

We can’t talk about the league’s most energetic full-backs without mentioning Adrien Truffert, who has continued where he left off last season. The Frenchman is the overlapping king, making more of those runs than any other full-back in the division (23). That comes after he made almost twice as many overlapping runs as any other player across the entire league last season. His manager, Andoni Iraola, may be gone, but he’s clearly got the same license to bomb on from Bournemouth’s new head coach, Marco Rose.

Iraola is now at Liverpool, and his full-backs are one of the most asymmetric duos in the league. Milos Kerkez – just as he did at Bournemouth under Iraola – has freedom to push forward and is one of the biggest overlappers in the league, completing 15 such runs thus far. On the other side, Ronald Araújo – who is more of a converted centre-back – plays a far more reserved role.

Manchester City are a curious case. Despite averaging the most possession in the division (65.4%), completing the most passes per game (566) and recording the highest territorial dominance, as measured by field tilt, Enzo Maresca’s team do not use their full-backs in advanced areas to exert that dominance.

Their average full-back touch location is 53.1 metres from goal, making them the fourth-deepest team in the division. That is a huge contrast from Pep Guardiola’s last season, when City ranked third-highest for average full-back positioning. There are plenty of ways to play full-back in the Premier League, but the growing importance of the position is the same for every team.
This is an article by Opta Analyst

items.titleZh: 重叠、内切还是后撤？英超球队如何使用边后卫
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳本赛季开局出色，本·怀特和卡拉菲奥里的边后卫组合触球位置高居英超之首。
bodyZh: 套边。内切。内收。传统。边后卫的角色发生了巨大的演变。这个曾经以防守为主、提供一些辅助进攻支持的位置，已经发展成为一个更加多面化的角色。
问问右后卫本·怀特就知道了，他和左路的里卡多·卡拉菲奥里一起，成为了阿森纳本赛季出色开局的重要人物。几年前在谈到这个位置时，他说：“按照[米克尔·阿尔特塔]想要的方式踢边后卫，与任何其他教练都完全不同。要想为他踢边后卫，你必须是一个中前卫、中后卫、边锋和10号球员。”
在本赛季的英超联赛中，怀特和卡拉菲奥里两人已经联手为阿森纳贡献了六个进球（怀特：三次助攻；卡拉菲奥里：一球两助）。到目前为止，没有任何其他后卫的参与进球数超过三个。阿森纳的这对双人组很好地说明了边后卫能够产生的影响。但是，随着这个位置的要求比以往任何时候都高，每支英超球队又是如何部署他们的边后卫的呢？
下图显示了每支英超球队边后卫触球的平均高度和宽度，按平均位置由高到低排序。最明显的结论是，本赛季阿森纳边后卫的平均触球位置是所有英超球队中最高的，距离本方球门58.2米。
这不仅反映了阿森纳在场上的绝对统治力，也体现了怀特和卡拉菲奥里被赋予了前插进入进攻线的自由。怀特平均每90分钟在对方禁区内触球3.4次，是联赛中所有边后卫或边翼卫中最多的。卡拉菲奥所以2.9次排名第三。
阿森纳边后卫的平均触球位置也是所有球队中最窄的，这强调了他们已经走得多远，不再局限于保持边路的传统边后卫角色。相反，他们被鼓励内切并在中路活动。
托特纳姆热刺也将他们的边后卫部署在球场极高的位置。在大部分比赛中，右后卫是阿奇·格雷，左后卫是安迪·罗伯逊。当然，分析一名球员的影响力不仅限于他在有球时的表现。多亏了Opta Vision，我们还可以追踪他们在无球时的表现。
鉴于其出色的工作投入度，格雷尤其值得关注。他在英超边后卫的内切跑动中排名第一，无论是总数（23次）还是每场90分钟（2.9次），同时他在每90分钟的套边跑动中也排名第四（1.8次）。这显示了在边后卫位置上部署一名进攻型球员的好处，格雷表现出了活力以及超越球并为进攻三区提供另一种选择的能力。
罗伯逊在另一侧边路也毫不逊色。这位32岁的球员在每90分钟内切跑动中排名第七（1.4次），在每90分钟套边跑动中稳居前20名（1.1次）。他还接收了比任何其他边后卫更多的终结在进攻三区的传球（159次）。
看到考文垂的边后卫位置如此靠前可能会让人感到有些惊讶，因为他们根本没有在控球率上占优（39.1%的控球率，倒数第二），而且他们的进攻发起位置很深（距离球门40.2米，倒数第六）。然而，他们在上赛季的英冠联赛中就很好地运用了这一点（平均高度56.8米，排名第六高）。
弗兰克·兰帕德有时也会使用五后卫阵型，这意味着他的边翼卫自然会踢得更高，但他在整体上推动防线前压方面一直非常勇敢。考文垂目前制造了英超第二多的越位次数（30次）。
这使得米兰·范埃维克和杰伊·达席尔瓦得以在边路向前推进。这两人各自创造了8次机会，天蓝色军团中只有杰克·鲁多尼（12次）创造了更多机会。
达席尔瓦是左路一个特别重要的出球点。他在球场更靠前的位置触球，超过了联赛中的任何其他边后卫，考文垂在进攻三区有42.2%的运动战机会都是通过他的这一侧创造的，这是所有英超球队中最高的比例。
诺丁汉森林和利兹联的边后卫触球位置也很高，这合情合理，因为他们是两支大量使用边翼卫的球队。这两支球队是仅有的四支主要使用边翼卫踢球的球队之四，三后卫/五后卫阵型在现代英超联赛中已不多见。
对利兹联来说，杰登·博格尔在进攻端的表现极具影响力。本赛季他完成的进入对方禁区的跑动次数超过了任何其他边后卫。他们的平均频率为每90分钟3.9次，在联赛中排名第二高，仅次于尼科·奥赖利，而后者只有54.3%的出场时间是踢边后卫。
与此同时，水晶宫正感受到失去有影响力的丹尼尔·穆尼奥斯的影响。尽管他们完全采用边翼卫阵型，但他们的边后卫平均战术定位已经从2025-26赛季英超联赛中最高，跌至本赛季的联赛平均水平以下。穆尼奥斯上赛季在右边路的上下奔跑不知疲倦，他的缺席显然影响了水晶宫将右边翼卫推到这些宽广区域的程度。
这位哥伦比亚球员目前效力于诺丁汉森林，与其前任主帅奥利弗·格拉斯纳重聚。他们的边后卫平均触球位置已经从倒数第五跃升至第四高。这不仅归功于穆尼奥斯，还因为拥有一个能够持续进行长距离冲刺的球员——他在无球跑动平均长度上仅次于伊普斯维奇镇的利夫·戴维斯——这带来了巨大的帮助。
提到联赛中最具活力的边后卫，就不能不提阿德里安·特吕费尔，他延续了上赛季的出色状态。这位法国人是套边之王，他的这类跑动次数比联赛中任何其他边后卫都要多（23次）。此前在上个赛季，他的套边跑动次数几乎是整个联赛中其他任何球员的两倍。他的主帅安多尼·伊劳拉可能已经离开，但他在伯恩茅斯新主帅马科·罗斯的麾下，显然获得了同样的自由向前冲击的许可。
伊劳拉现在执教利物浦，他的边后卫是联赛中最不对称的双人组之一。米洛斯·克尔克兹——正如他在伊劳拉手下的伯恩茅斯那样——拥有前插的自由，并且是联赛中最主要的套边球员之一，到目前为止已经完成了15次此类跑动。在另一侧，罗纳德·阿劳霍——他更像是一个由中后卫改造成地球员——扮演着更加保守的角色。
曼城是一个奇怪的例子。尽管恩佐·马雷斯卡率领的球队拥有联赛最高的平均控球率（65.4%）、完成了最多的单场传球（566次），并记录了以球场倾斜度衡量的最高领地统治力，但他们并没有利用边后卫在先进区域来施加这种统治力。
他们边后卫的平均触球位置距离球门53.1米，是联赛中第四靠后的球队。这与佩普·瓜迪奥拉执教的最后一个赛季形成了巨大对比，当时曼城边后卫的平均定位排名第三高。在英超联赛中踢边后卫有很多种方法，但这个位置日益增长的重要性对每支球队来说都是一样的。
这是一篇由Opta Analyst撰写的文章。

items.titleEn: Peter Storey, Arsenal Double winner and England international, dies aged 81
items.summaryEn: Storey made 501 appearances for Arsenal from 1965He won 19 England caps and finished career at FulhamArsenal have paid tribute to Peter Storey, a key member of their 1971 Double-winning team, after the death of the former England midfielder at the age of 81.Storey was part of the Bertie Mee team that secured the First Division title and FA Cup in a season that remains one of the most celebrated in Arsenal’s history and played 501 times for the club. That places him eighth on their appearances list. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Arsenal have paid tribute to Peter Storey, a key member of their 1971 Double-winning team, after the death of the former England midfielder at the age of 81.

Storey was part of the Bertie Mee team that secured the First Division title and FA Cup in a season that remains one of the most celebrated in Arsenal’s history and played 501 times for the club. That places him eighth on their appearances list.
Storey, who represented England on 19 occasions from 1971-73, earned respect for his uncompromising approach and versatility, also featuring at right-back.

Storey died in hospital after a short illness, surrounded by his family. Arsenal said: “Everyone at Arsenal is deeply saddened by the passing of 1970-71 Double winner Peter Storey. All our thoughts are with his family and loved ones at this incredibly sad time.”

Born in Surrey, Storey began his career at Arsenal and made his debut shortly after his 20th birthday in 1965. He is fondly remembered by the club’s fans for scoring a stoppage-time penalty in the 1971 FA Cup semi-final against Stoke that forced a replay and kept the Double dream alive.

Storey left for Fulham in 1977 and retired eight months later when his contract was cancelled, going on to own a pub in north London. He was later convicted of several criminal offences, including financing a plot to counterfeit gold coins and smuggling pornography. He released an autobiography, True Storey: My Life and Crimes as a Football Hatchet Man, in September 2010.

Storey’s family said: “We are deeply grateful for the many kind messages, tributes and good wishes we have received. It has been a great comfort to see the affection and respect in which he was held by so many, both within the football community and beyond.”

items.titleZh: 阿森纳双冠王得主兼英格兰国脚彼得·斯托瑞去世，享年81岁
items.summaryZh: 前阿森纳中场、1971年双冠王功臣彼得·斯托瑞逝世，享年81岁。
bodyZh: 阿森纳向彼得·斯托瑞致以敬意。这位前英格兰中场球员去世，享年81岁，他是阿森纳1971年双冠王阵容的关键成员。
斯托瑞效力于伯蒂·米率领的球队，在那个阿森纳历史上最著名的赛季中夺得甲级联赛冠军和足总杯冠军。他为俱乐部出场501次，在队史出场次数榜上排名第八。
斯托瑞在1971年至1973年间代表英格兰国家队出场19次，他以凶悍的防守风格和多面手属性赢得尊重，也曾担任右后卫。
斯托瑞在经历短暂疾病后于医院去世，家属陪伴在侧。阿森纳表示：“阿森纳的每个人都对1970-71赛季双冠王得主彼得·斯托瑞的离去深感悲痛。在这个极其悲伤的时刻，我们所有的心都与他的家属和亲人在一起。”
斯托瑞出生于萨里，在阿森纳开始职业生涯，1965年在20岁生日后不久完成首秀。俱乐部球迷对他在1971年足总杯半决赛对阵斯托克城的比赛中罚入伤停补时点球记忆犹新，这粒进球迫使比赛进入重赛，并延续了双冠王梦想。
斯托瑞于1977年转会富勒姆，并在八个月后合同终止时退役，随后在伦敦北部经营一家酒吧。他后来因多项刑事犯罪被定罪，包括资助伪造金币阴谋和走私色情制品。2010年9月，他出版了自传《真实故事：我作为足球恶汉的生活与罪行》。
斯托瑞的家属表示：“我们非常感激收到的许多暖心留言、致敬和祝福。看到足球界内外的许多人对他的喜爱和尊敬，给我们带来了极大的安慰。”

items.titleEn: Peter Storey: 1945-2026
items.summaryEn: We are saddened to hear of the loss of Peter Storey, a vital part of our 1970/71 double-winning side
bodyEn: Everyone at Arsenal is deeply saddened by the passing of 1970/71 double winner, Peter Storey.

Peter joined the club as an apprentice in 1961 and made his first-team debut against Leicester City in October 1965. Initially starting his time with the club as a right-back, he would make 501 appearances across the next decade, placing him eighth in our all-time highest appearance makers.

His reputation as a tough tackler was well deserved; Johnny Giles of Leeds United admitted that Peter was the hardest player he had ever faced. Nonetheless, he was also good on the ball. Bertie Mee and Don Howe recognised that, converting him into a central midfielder, where he helped us win the Fairs Cup in 1970 and that famous double a year later.
He was a vital member of the 1970/71 squad, with his crucial contribution coming in March 1971 as we stared defeat in the face during our FA Cup semi-final against Stoke City at Hillsborough.

Peter had already halved a two-goal deficit with a rasping second-half drive but the Potters looked set to seal a 2-1 victory and book their place at Wembley, before we were awarded a stoppage-time penalty for a handball on the goalline.

The yellow-shirted Gunners leapt with joy - but not Peter. He had the unenviable task of beating England legend Gordon Banks from 12 yards to keep our double dream alive. He saw Banks go right and slotted the ball low to the keeper's left, as cool as you like to force a replay, which we went on to win and ultimately lift the cup.

Peter, who scored 17 times for us in all competitions, earned an England call-up in 1971 and went on to win 19 caps, mainly in his favoured midfield role. He left Highbury in 1977 and saw out his career at Fulham before retiring in 1978.
We will pay our respects to Peter at our forthcoming home match against Borussia Dortmund.
All our thoughts are with his family and loved ones at this incredibly sad time.

items.summaryZh: 我们沉痛悼念皮特·斯托里，他是我们1970/71赛季双冠王阵容的重要成员。
bodyZh: 阿森纳的每个人都对1970/71赛季双冠王成员皮特·斯托里的离去感到无比悲痛。
皮特于1961年作为学徒加入俱乐部，并于1965年10月对阵莱斯特城的比赛中完成一线队首秀。他最初是一名右后卫，在随后的十年里共出场501次，在我们的队史出场次数排行榜上位列第八。
他作为凶悍铲球手的声誉实至名归；利兹联的约翰尼·吉尔斯承认皮特是他面对过最难缠的球员。尽管如此，他的脚下技术同样出色。伯蒂·米和唐·豪意识到这一点，将他改造成了一名中场中路球员，这帮助我们在1970年赢得了国际城市博览会杯，并在一年后赢得了那次著名的双冠王。
他是1970/71赛季阵容的核心成员，他在1971年3月希尔斯堡球场对阵斯托克城的足总杯半决赛中做出了至关重要的贡献，当时我们正面临失利的绝境。
皮特此前已经通过一记下半场的劲射将两球的劣势缩小了一半，但陶工似乎即将锁定2-1的胜利并预订温布利席位，随后我们在伤停补时阶段因门线手球获得了一个点球。
身穿黄色球衣的枪手们欢欣雀跃——但皮特没有。他承担了在12码外击败英格兰传奇门将戈登·班克斯这一让人艳羡不来的任务，以延续我们的双冠王梦想。他看到班克斯扑向右侧，随后冷静地将球推射入门将的左侧低角，逼平了比分并将比赛拖入重赛，随后我们赢得了重赛并最终捧起奖杯。
皮特各项赛事共为我们攻入17球，他在1971年首次入选英格兰代表队并最终获得19次出场机会，主要司职他喜爱中场位置。他于1977年离开海布里，并在富勒姆结束了职业生涯，于1978年退役。
我们将在即将到来的对阵多特蒙德的主场比赛中向皮特致敬。
在这个无比悲伤的时刻，我们所有的思念都与他的家人和挚爱同在。

items.titleEn: Max Dowman's incredible list of records for club and country
items.summaryEn: Max Dowman continues to break records and hit milestones for both Arsenal and England - here is every one he currently holds
bodyEn: Having starred now for both us and England's under-21s on the international stage, Max Dowman is the proud owner of a plethora of records for the Three Lions and us.
The 16-year-old’s exploits are hard to keep track of, so here are all of the accolades he’s achieved already in his fledgling career:
PREMIER LEAGUE RECORDS
Max began making history in August 2025, coming off the bench against Leeds United to become the Premier League’s second-youngest player, only behind our own Ethan Nwaneri.

That kicked off his breakout campaign, which climaxed in March 2026 when he scored a magnificent solo goal to seal a huge 2-0 win against Everton, aiding our championship challenge and making him the Premier League’s youngest scorer.

Aged just 16 years and 73 days, Max shattered the milestone by 197 days, held for two decades by James Vaughan, who scored for Everton against Crystal Palace in April 2005. Incredibly, playing, and indeed scoring, for the Toffees that day was Mikel Arteta.
Premier League's youngest scorers
The season concluded with Max being named in our starting XI against Crystal Palace on the final day, and thus becoming the division’s youngest-ever starter:
Premier League's youngest starters

A couple of hours later he got his hands on the Premier League trophy. Having played six times in the top-flight during the campaign, he had surpassed the threshold required to be awarded a winner’s medal, and obliterated the record held by Manchester City’s Phil Foden to become the youngest player to own one:
Youngest players to win the Premier League
CLUB RECORDS

After making his professional bow against Leeds, Max was named in our starting XI the following month for our Carabao Cup fourth-round win against Brighton, becoming the youngest starter in our history.

Aged just 15 years and 302 days old, Max broke the record set the previous season when Jack Porter was named between the posts against Bolton Wanderers in the same competition. Max beat him by 135 days and became the first player to start a game for us aged 16 or younger:
Arsenal's youngest starters

As well as achieving something no player in Premier League history has done earlier in their lifetime by scoring against Everton, Max overtook Cesc Fabregas at the top of our standings, breaking a record that had stood longer than Vaughan's.

Back in December 2003 - six years before Max was born - the fresh-faced Spaniard made a name for himself when he netted in a League Cup tie against Wolves, aged 16 years and 212 days. That means Max beat Cesc by 139 days to move to the top of our club goalscoring standings as well:
Arsenal's youngest scorers
CHAMPIONS LEAGUE RECORDS

Max made more history against Slavia Prague in November 2025, becoming the youngest player ever to feature in the Champions League. After being introduced from the bench in the 72nd minute during our 3-0 success, Max became the first 15-year-old to play in the competition since it was rebranded in 1992.
Max beat the previous record set by Youssoufa Moukoko, who was 16 years and 18 days old when he played for Borussia Dortmund against Zenit St Petersburg in December 2020.
Champions League's youngest players

Another target in Max’s sights could be to become the youngest scorer in Champions League history. That honour is currently held by Ansu Fati, who was 17 years and 40 days old when he scored for Barcelona in a 2-1 win at the San Siro against Inter Milan, meaning Max has until February 2027 to surpass him.
ENGLAND RECORDS

Fast-tracked from the under-16s, Max made his England under-17 bow in September 2024 aged 14 years and 248 days, ending Nathaniel Chalobah's 15-year record. A goal in that game against Mexico saw him also take the under-17s' youngest scorer crown from Nwaneri.

A year later and he made under-19 history when he appeared at that level for the first time, aged 15 years and 246 days. He remains the only 15-year-old to play for the under-19s, and a strike against Wales the following month saw him add another Three Lions honour.

Max was called up for the under-21s in November 2026 for a pair of friendly matches. He came on in the 61st minute against Portugal to win his first cap at that level, and broke Jude Bellingham’s record as the youngest player to play for the Three Lions’ under-21 side:
England under-21s' youngest players
Three days later, he started against France and, in the 89th minute, tucked home the winner in a 3-2 victory at Bramall Lane, also ending Bellingham’s run as the youngest scorer for the Young Lions:
England under-21s' youngest scorers

Max won't get the opportunity to claim Theo Walcott's honour as the Three Lions' youngest player, as by the next international break he'll be older than Theo was when he debuted in 2006, aged 17 years and 75 days. However, should he score for England before November 12, 2027, he could break Wayne Rooney's record as his nation's youngest scorer, which has stood since 2003.
ACADEMY RECORDS
Whilst his first-team exploits have been extraordinary, Max had been making a name for himself before he’d appeared for Mikel Arteta’s side.

Having played for our under-18 side aged just 13 in the 2022/23 season, Max still holds the record as the youngest player to score in the UEFA Youth League, being just 14 years and 263 days old when he scored on his debut in the under-19s competition against Atalanta in September 2024.
UEFA Youth League's youngest scorers

He was the second-youngest player in Youth League history at that point, but that record is now held by our own Luis Munoz, who was 13 years and 343 days old when he played against Bayern Munich in November 2025, although he missed out on Max's goalscoring record by just a couple of days when he scored againstNapoli back in September.
Max remains the youngest player to play in the Premier League 2, when he turned out for our under-21s aged 14 years and 336 days old against Brighton in December 2024.
Premier League 2's youngest players

That also saw him become the first 14-year-old to play for what is effectively our reserve team, surpassing Nwaneri who was 15 years and 166 days old when he made his PL2 bow, just two weeks before turning out for us in the Premier League against Brentford. Going further back, Richie Powling was a regular in our reserve side in the 1971/72 season despite being just 15.

items.titleZh: 马克·多曼创造的俱乐部与国家队各项纪录惊人清单
items.summaryZh: 马克·多曼不断为阿森纳和英格兰刷新纪录，以下是他目前保持的所有纪录。
bodyZh: 在阿森纳和英格兰U21代表队的国际舞台上大放异彩之后，马克·多曼目前拥有大量属于三狮军团和我们的纪录。
这位16岁小将的成就不胜枚举，以下是他职业生涯初期已经斩获的各项荣誉：
英超纪录
马克在2025年8月开始创造历史，他在对阵利兹联的比赛中替补登场，成为英超历史第二年轻的球员，仅次于我们自己的伊森·恩瓦内里。
这开启了他的爆发赛季，并在2026年3月达到高潮，当时他打入了一记精彩的个人进球，帮助球队以2-0击败埃弗顿，助力我们的争冠征程，同时也使他成为英超历史最年轻的进球者。
年仅16岁零73天的马克将由詹姆斯·沃恩在2005年4月代表埃弗顿对阵水晶宫时创造、并保持了二十年的纪录打破了197天。令人难以置信的是，当天的比赛中，埃弗顿阵中出场并取得进球的正是米克尔·阿尔特塔。
英超最年轻进球者
赛季结束时，马克在收官战对阵水晶宫的比赛中进入了我们的首发阵容，从而成为了该联赛历史上最年轻的首发球员：
英超最年轻首发球员
几个小时后，他捧起了英超冠军奖杯。在该赛季的顶级联赛中出场6次后，他达到了获得冠军奖牌所需的出场次数门槛，并打破了由曼城球员菲尔·福登保持的纪录，成为拥有该奖牌最年轻的球员：
赢得英超的最年轻球员
俱乐部纪录
在对阵利兹联完成职业生涯首秀后，马克在接下来的一个月里入选了我们在联赛杯第四轮对阵布莱顿的首发阵容，成为了我们队史最年轻的首发球员。
年仅15岁零302天的马克打破了上赛季杰克·波特在同一赛事中对阵博尔顿流浪者时首发出场所创造的纪录。马克将纪录缩短了135天，成为第一位以16岁或更小年龄为我们首发登场的球员：
阿森纳最年轻首发球员
除了通过对阵埃弗顿打破了英超历史上任何球员都未曾达到的年轻进球纪录外，马克还超越了塞斯克·法布雷加斯，登顶我们的队史纪录榜，打破了一项比沃恩的纪录保持得更久的纪录。
早在2003年12月——也就是马克出生六年前——这位面容清秀的西班牙人在对阵狼队的联赛杯比赛中破门，当时他年仅16岁零212天，从而崭露头角。这意味着马克超越了塞斯克139天，同样登顶了我们的俱乐部最年轻进球者榜首：
阿森纳最年轻进球者
欧冠纪录
2025年11月对阵布拉格斯拉维亚的比赛中，马克创造了更多历史，成为欧冠历史上出场最年轻的球员。在我们在该场比赛中以3-0取胜、并在第72分钟替补登场后，马克成为了自1992年欧冠改制以来首位在该赛事中出场的15岁球员。
马克打破了优素法·穆科科此前创造的纪录，后者在2020年12月代表多特蒙德对阵圣彼得堡泽尼特时年仅16岁零18天。
欧冠最年轻球员
马克眼前的另一个目标可能是成为欧冠历史上最年轻的进球者。这一荣誉目前由安苏·法蒂保持，他在圣西罗球场代表巴塞罗那以2-1战胜国际米兰的比赛中进球时年仅17岁零40天，这意味着马克直到2027年2月前都还有机会超越他。
英格兰纪录
从U16越级晋升后，马克于2024年9月迎来了他的英格兰U17首秀，当时他年仅14岁零248天，打破了纳撒尼尔·查洛巴保持了15年的纪录。他在对阵墨西哥的比赛中取得进球，也从恩瓦内里手中夺走了U17最年轻进球者的桂冠。
一年后，他在首次代表U19出场时创造了历史，当时他年仅15岁零246天。他依然是唯一一位代表U19出场的15岁球员，并在接下来的一个月对阵威尔士的比赛中斩获进球，为自己增添了另一项三狮军团的荣誉。
2026年11月，马克被征召参加U21的两场友谊赛。他在对阵葡萄牙的比赛中于第61分钟替补登场，完成了他在该级别赛事的第一场比赛，并打破了裘德·贝林厄姆保持的纪录，成为了三狮军团U21梯队出场最年轻的球员：
英格兰U21最年轻球员
三天后，他在对阵法国的比赛中首发，并在布拉莫斯巷球场进行的比赛进行到第89分钟时打入制胜球，帮助球队以3-2取胜，同时他也终结了贝林厄姆作为小狮子军团最年轻进球者的纪录：
英格兰U21最年轻进球者
马克将没有机会夺走沃尔科特作为三狮军团最年轻出场球员的荣誉，因为到下一个国际比赛日时，他的年龄将超过沃尔科特在2006年完成首秀时的17岁零75天。不过，如果他在2027年11月12日之前代表英格兰进球，他将有机会打破韦恩·鲁尼自2003年起保持的国家队最年轻进球者纪录。
青训纪录
尽管他的成年队战绩非凡，但在为米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队出场之前，马克就已经名声在外。
早在2022/23赛季年仅13岁时，马克就曾代表我们的U18梯队出场，他至今仍保持着欧青赛最年轻进球者的纪录，在2024年9月对阵亚特兰大的U19赛事中完成首秀并取得进球时，他年仅14岁零263 days。
欧青赛最年轻进球者
当时他是欧青赛历史上第二年轻的球员，但这一纪录目前由我们自己的路易斯·穆尼奥斯保持，他在2025年11月对阵拜仁慕尼黑时年仅13岁零343天，不过他在9月对阵那不勒斯时进球，错失了马克的进球纪录仅几天时间。
马克仍然是英超2中出场最年轻的球员，他在2024年12月对阵布莱顿的比赛中代表我们的U21梯队出场，当时年仅14岁零336天。
英超2最年轻球员
这也使他成为第一位代表我们实质上的预备队出场的14岁球员，超越了恩瓦内里（后者在完成PL2首秀时年仅15岁零166天，就在他在英超对阵布伦特福德的比赛中登场前两周）。再往回看，里奇·波林在1971/72赛季尽管年仅15岁，却曾是我们预备队的常客。

items.summaryEn: Four members of our women’s team have been called up for international duty with England in December.
bodyEn: Four members of our women’s team have been called up for international duty with England in December.
Taylor Hinds, Alessia Russo, Georgia Stanway and Leah Williamson are all in Sarina Wiegman’s squad.

The Lionesses will take on Ukraine away from home at 5pm on Tuesday, December 1, before hosting Ukraine in the second leg of FIFA Women’s World Cup second round qualifying at 5.30pm on Saturday, December 5.
These are must-win matches as England look to book their place in the 2027 World Cup!
To get to this stage, England beat Greece 8-1 on aggregate in the first round of qualifying play-offs after finishing second in Group C.

items.titleEn: Gyokeres challenging Gunners greats with scoring spree
items.summaryEn: Viktor Gyokeres is on fire for Sweden, but where does he rank among our international scoring greats?
bodyEn: Viktor Gyokeres is on a hot streak with his country Sweden after firing them to back-to-back promotions in the UEFA Nations League.
The Swede has netted in eight straight Nations League matches after bagging a brace in a win over Bosnia & Herzegovina.
Those numbers mean he's on an exceptional goalscoring run for his nation since his arrival in north London, putting him in esteemed company.
NATIONS LEAGUE HERO

After bagging nine goals in the 2024/25 Nations League campaign, Viktor has been proving his worth for his country in this season's competition, scoring in all five matches so far against Poland, Romania and Bosnia.
His recent double against the Bosnians means he leapfrogged Serbia's Aleksandar Mitrovic and Portugal's Cristiano Ronald into second place on the all-time list of scorers in the competition.
It's been six years since Sweden were in the top division, but thanks to Viktor's goals, Sweden will be heading for League A for the next edition of the competition.
INTERNATIONAL GOAL MACHINES

Viktor has netted 12 goals in just 16 international appearances since signing for Arsenal. His first three came in one match as he netted a dramatic late winner in a 3-2 win over Poland to book a place at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Gyokeres' red-hot form means he's chasing down our greats of international football.
A host of Gunners have made their mark on the international stage while at Arsenal, including three of Viktor's teammates.
Thierry Henry is the highest international goalscorer while playing for Arsenal, with 36 of his 51 goals coming during his time in north London.
Nine players rank above Viktor in the list below. Should he find the net more than once in Sweden's final game against Poland, our no.14 could catapult himself up the rankings.

items.titleZh: 哲科雷斯神勇表现追赶阿森纳传奇射手群
items.summaryZh: 维克托·哲科雷斯在国家队状态火热，其进球效率比肩俱乐部传奇。
bodyZh: 在带领瑞典队在欧国联实现连续升级后，维克托·哲科雷斯正处于火热的竞技状态中。
在对阵波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的比赛中独中两元后，这位瑞典前锋已经在各项欧国联比赛中连续八场破门。
这些数据意味着自他加盟北伦敦以来，他在国家队开启了一段卓越的进球潮，使其跻身精英行列。
欧国联英雄
在2024/25赛季的欧国联征程中打入九球后，维克托在本赛季的比赛中继续证明自己的国家队价值，在迄今为止对阵波兰、罗马尼亚和波斯尼亚的五场比赛中场场进球。
他最近在对阵波斯尼亚时的梅开二度，使他在该项赛事的历史射手榜上超越了塞尔维亚的亚历山大·米特罗维奇和葡萄牙的克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多，升至第二位。
瑞典队阔别顶级联赛已有六年之久，但多亏了维克托的进球，瑞典队将在下一届欧国联赛事中升入A级。
国际赛场进球机器
自签约阿森纳以来，维克托在仅仅16场国家队比赛中就攻入了12球。他的前三粒进球来自于一场对阵波兰的比赛中，他上演了戏剧性的绝杀，帮助球队3比2取胜并锁定2026年国际足联世界杯席位。
哲科雷斯火热的状态意味着他正在追赶我们的国际足坛传奇。
许多阿森纳球员在效力阿森纳期间都在国际舞台上留下了印记，其中包括维克托的三名队友。
蒂埃里·亨利是效力阿森纳期间进球最多的国际球员，在他总共51粒进球中有36粒是在北伦敦效力期间打进的。
在下面的榜单中，有九名球员的排名高于维克托。如果这位身披14号战袍的球员在瑞典队对阵波兰队的最后一场比赛中再次斩获多球，他将实现排名的大幅跃升。

bodyEn: Declan Rice has agreed a new five-year contract at Arsenal, with the England midfielder poised to match Bukayo Saka’s status as the highest-paid player at the Premier League champions.

Representatives for Rice, who won his 82nd cap in England’s thrilling win over Spain on Sunday, have been in talks for months about extending the deal he signed in 2023 after a record £105m move from West Ham. That is believed to be worth about £250,000 a week and is due to expire in 2028, although Arsenal have the option of a further 12 months.

Rice’s new contract will expire in 2031 and includes a substantial pay rise, rewarding him for his status as one of Mikel Arteta’s key players and taking his salary to about £300,000 a week. Saka signed his new five-year contract last season.

Rice was a driving force in Arsenal ending their 22-year wait to be champions in May, although the second half of his campaign was hampered by back and hamstring injuries. The 27-year-old admitted last week he had an “average” World Cup as a result, although he looked back to his best against Spain.

Arsenal have also agreed a contract extension for Jurriën Timber, whose deal is due to expire in 2028. The Dutchman, recently back from a groin injury that forced him to miss the World Cup, has been one of Arteta’s most consistent performers since joining from Ajax in 2023.

The Arsenal manager committed his future by signing a new four-year deal last month that could take him beyond a decade in charge. Arteta and the sporting director, Andrea Berta, have prioritised securing their top players on long-term contracts over the past year and talks are believed to be ongoing with David Raya and Piero Hincapié.

items.titleZh: 德克兰·赖斯同意与阿森纳续约，成为队内薪资最高的球员之一
items.summaryZh: 赖斯同意与阿森纳续约至2031年，周薪约30万英镑，廷贝尔也同意续约。
bodyZh: 德克兰·赖斯已同意与阿森纳续签一份为期五年的新合同，这位英格兰中场将追平布卡约·萨卡，成为这家英超冠军俱乐部中薪资最高的球员。
赖斯的经纪团队与俱乐部进行了数月的谈判。周日，他在英格兰战胜西班牙的精彩比赛中赢得了个人第82场国家队出场。他此前在2023年以创纪录的1.05亿英镑从西汉姆联转会时签下的合同原定于2028年到期（阿森纳拥有延长12个月的选项），据信当时周薪约为25万英镑。
赖斯的新合同将于2031年到期，其中包括大幅加薪，以表彰他作为米克尔·阿尔特塔阵中核心球员的地位，其周薪将增至约30万英镑。萨卡则在上赛季签下了他的五年新合同。
在阿森纳于5月份结束长达22年的等待夺得英格兰顶级联赛冠军的过程中，赖斯是球队的重要推动力量，尽管他赛季的后半程受到了背部和腿筋伤病的困扰。这位27岁的球员上周承认，因此他的世界杯表现“一般”，但在对阵西班牙时他看起来已经恢复了最佳状态。
阿森纳还与尤里恩·廷贝尔就续约达成了协议，这名荷兰国脚原本的合同将于2028年到期。他最近从导致其缺席世界杯的腹股沟伤势中恢复，自2023年从阿贾克斯加盟以来，一直是阿尔特塔麾下表现最稳定的球员之一。
阿森纳主帅在上个月签署了一份为期四年的新合同，这可能会让他在俱乐部的执教时间超过十年。在过去的一年里，阿尔特塔和体育总监安德烈·贝尔塔一直将确保核心球员签订长期合同作为首要任务，据信目前正在与大卫·拉亚和皮耶罗·因卡皮耶进行续约谈判。

bodyEn: Valerie Fiesser will never forget her surprise when Bukayo Saka contacted her out of the blue in 2022, asking whether he could help support a project in Nigeria. “I remember thinking: ‘Is this really Bukayo writing us an email?’” says the president of BigShoe, a non-profit organisation based in Frankfurt that has helped more than 10,000 children worldwide. “But that’s how he is. He’s always asking what more we can do.”

Four years on from that unexpected email, Fiesser was given the secret task of reaching out for a letter for Saka to read from the podium when he was presented with the Sócrates award at last month’s Ballon d’Or ceremony in London for his humanitarian work. She got the words from Byiringiro, a 14-year-old from Rwanda who had his eyesight restored after having surgery thanks to a BigShoe initiative.

“They told me he was going to receive the award, but he didn’t know, so they asked whether I could get a letter from one of the children we had helped,” Fiesser says. “I was really proud of Bukayo, I think the way he did it was really special. He stood there so strongly for all these children around the world that nobody sees and nobody hears. He gave them a voice. He took the attention away from himself and put it into action. That’s how I know Bukayo. It’s never about him, it’s always about the people we help. He’s incredible.”

Saka, who donated more than 1,000 school uniforms to children in his home borough of Ealing in west London last year to help with the cost of living crisis, is understood to have heard about BigShoe from Antonio Rüdiger after the Real Madrid and Germany defender told him about some of the work he had done with the organisation, including in Sierra Leone.
BigShoe has also worked with Philipp Lahm and Mesut Özil. Fiesser says Saka and his family have taken a particularly close interest in projects he supports.

“When we had 150 life-changing surgeries taking place in Nigeria, he would message me asking to see pictures,” she says. “He wanted to know what was happening and whether everybody was safe. He always asks whether the team has returned safely. I don’t know how he manages to find the time, but he does.

“His family are very similar. They genuinely want to make a big impact and provide meaningful help. I wouldn’t describe Bukayo as simply a donor to BigShoe. He’s more like a member of the BigShoe team. I know that he stands behind us.”

BigShoe was established by four friends in Germany after the 2006 World Cup. As part of its latest projects in Rwanda and Nigeria, about 3,000 people had eye examinations and were given glasses if required. “Giving a child a pair of glasses can change their life,” Fiesser says. “We also help entire families. If a father can’t see properly, he might not be able to work or read. That affects the whole family.”

BigShoe recently renovated a school in Rwanda and provided clean drinking water through a filtration system. It has also built a library and provided private changing facilities for girls. “Once a month, some girls miss school because they don’t have suitable facilities or somewhere private to change,” says Fiesser. “We built facilities so they can continue attending school and have a quiet, private area.”

Saka’s hectic playing schedule means he has yet to make a visit, but his family have been on the ground in Rwanda and he was heavily involved in funding earthquake relief projects in Morocco and Turkey. “We provided container homes for people affected by the earthquakes,” says Fiesser. “I knew I could count on him. It’s always important to Bukayo that we make a big impact. He doesn’t want money to be wasted. When I present a project to him, he wants to understand it properly. He needs to know exactly what we’re doing before he makes a decision. He’s a 100% person. Whatever he does, he gives it everything.”

Saka’s mother, Adenike, is believed to be a driving force behind her son’s charitable work. Fiesser describes her as “one of the most amazing women I’ve met”. Plans are being made for the next projects, which include providing health insurance to families in Nigeria and food packages for children in Rwanda over Christmas, even if Saka has typically been pushing for something more long-term.

“He doesn’t just want to give someone food,” Fiesser says. “Of course, food is important, and we’re providing that too, but he wants to change lives. You can help someone, but if the help doesn’t last, then it hasn’t achieved what you really wanted. If we all work together, it doesn’t matter which team we’re supporting or which country we’re helping. We’re all part of one world.”

items.titleZh: “他想要改变生活”：布卡约·萨卡荣获苏格拉底奖背后的故事
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳前锋萨卡因支持慈善组织BigShoe并致力于人道主义工作而荣获苏格拉底奖。
bodyZh: 瓦莱丽·菲瑟永远不会忘记2002年（注：原文如此）布卡约·萨卡突然联系她时她有多么惊讶，当时他询问是否可以资助尼日利亚的一个项目。“我记得当时想：‘真的是布卡约在给我们发邮件吗？’”总部位于法兰克福的非营利组织BigShoe的主席说道，该组织已在全球帮助了1万多名儿童。“但他就是这样的人。他总是问我们还能做些什么。”
距离那封意想不到的电子邮件过去四年后，菲瑟接到了一项秘密任务，要求她去获取一封信件，以便萨卡上个月在伦敦举行的金球奖颁奖典礼上因其人道主义工作被授予苏格拉底奖时在领奖台上朗读。这封信来自14岁的卢旺达男孩拜里吉罗，他在BigShoe项目的资助下接受了手术，恢复了视力。
“他们告诉我他将获得这个奖项，但他自己并不知道，所以他们问我是否能从我们帮助过的孩子们那里弄到一封信，”菲瑟说。“我为布卡约感到非常骄傲，我认为他这样做的方式非常特别。他坚定地站在世界各地那些无人看见、无人听闻的孩子们身后。他为他们发声。他把聚光灯从自己身上移开，付诸实际行动。这就是我所了解的布卡约。这从来都不是为了他自己，永远是为了我们所帮助的人。他太不可思议了。”
据了解，萨卡去年向伦敦西部伊灵家乡自治市的儿童捐赠了1000多套校服以帮助应对生活成本危机，他是从安东尼奥·吕迪格那里听说BigShoe的，这位皇家马德里和德国队后卫曾向他讲述了自己与该组织合作的一些工作，包括在塞拉利昂的工作。
BigShoe还曾与菲利普·拉姆和梅苏特·厄齐尔合作。菲瑟表示，萨卡和他的家人对萨卡支持的项目表现出了特别密切的关注。
“当我们有150例改变人生的手术在尼日利亚进行时，他会给我发信息要求看照片，”她说。“他想知道发生了什么，以及每个人是否都安全。他总是询问团队是否安全返回。我不知道他是如何腾出时间的，但他确实做到了。”
“他的家人也非常相似。他们真诚地希望产生巨大的影响并提供有意义的帮助。我不会将布卡约简单地描述为BigShoe的捐赠者。他更像是BigShoe团队的一员。我知道他坚定地支持我们。”
BigShoe是由四位德国朋友在2006年世界杯后创立的。作为其在卢旺达和尼日利亚最新项目的一部分，约有3000人接受了视力检查并在需要时获得了眼镜。“给孩子一副眼镜可以改变他们的生活，”菲瑟说。“我们还帮助整个家庭。如果一位父亲看不清东西，他可能无法工作或阅读。这会影响整个家庭。”
BigShoe最近翻新了卢旺达的一所学校，并通过过滤系统提供了干净的饮用水。它还建立了一个图书馆，并为女孩们提供了私密的更衣设施。“一个月下来，有些女孩因为没有合适的设施或私密的地方更衣而缺课，”菲瑟说。“我们建造了这些设施，这样她们就可以继续上学，并拥有一个安静、私密的区域。”

由于萨卡繁忙的比赛日程，他还没能亲自前往访问，但他的家人曾在卢旺达实地考察，并且他积极参与了资助摩洛哥和土耳其地震救援项目。“我们为受地震影响的人们提供了集装箱房屋，”菲瑟说。“我知道我可以指望他。对布卡约来说，产生重大影响总是很重要的。他不想浪费金钱。当我向他呈报一个项目时，他希望彻底理解它。在做出决定之前，他需要确切地知道我们在做什么。他是一个百分之百投入的人。无论做什么，他都倾尽所有。”
萨卡的母亲阿德尼克被认为是推动她儿子慈善工作的主要力量。菲瑟形容她为“我见过最了不起的女性之一”。各项计划正在为下一个项目做准备，其中包括为尼日利亚家庭提供健康保险，并在圣诞节期间为卢旺达儿童提供食品包，尽管萨卡一如既往地在推动更长期的东西。
“他不仅仅想给某人提供食物，”菲瑟说。“当然，食物很重要，我们也在提供食物，但他想要改变生活。你可以帮助某人，但如果这种帮助无法持久，那就没有达到你真正想要的。如果我们齐心协力，我们支持哪支球队或我们帮助哪个国家并不重要。我们都是同一个世界的一部分。”

bodyEn: It would have been very easy for Oliver Glasner to lose patience with Liam Delap. The forward is still only 23, yet the days when he was rattling in 12 in a Premier League season for Ipswich have come to seem a very long time ago (and his six games for Manchester City even longer). A season at Chelsea had left him bereft of confidence, an odd mix of diffidence and overaggression, devoid of composure in the box, arms flailing like a broken windmill. But the old gifts have not left him. Both goals on Saturday were the result of great muscular surges and if the first finish seemed essentially about hitting the ball as hard as possible on target, the second was a precise – and still powerful – finish in off the far post. After games such as this it’s possible to imagine him as England’s long-term replacement for Harry Kane. Jonathan Wilson
Match report: Nottingham Forest 3-1 Manchester City

Amid the chaotic blur of proceedings at Old Trafford, there was one outstanding performance. Alysson had only one goal to his name in his Premier League career at Aston Villa, but he scored one and helped set up another two in the first 48 minutes against Manchester United. The 20-year-old winger, who has represented Brazil only at under-16 level, was signed from Grêmio for an initial £8.7m last January. His only goal in 18 previous appearances was against Nottingham Forest in September – it took less than a minute to open the scoring at United and less than four for his saved shot to rebound out to Nicolas Jackson for Villa’s second. United’s right-back, Diogo Dalot, was too slow to close Alysson down for his opener and did not have any complaints when his trip on the Brazilian conceded a penalty at the start of the second half. Dalot, often the face of United’s struggles, was booed off when substituted in the second half – Alysson was applauded off by the away end. Billy Munday
Match report: Manchester United 4-4 Aston Villa

Diego Gómez is the latest example of a slow-burning Brighton player given the chance and space to bed in before then flourishing. His current status is as an overnight sensation, though a taste for the spectacular and an eye for goal have been obvious since two goals against Leeds in November 2025. Gómez had signed from Inter Miami that January. The inside-right position from which he drilled his left-foot sidewinder to open the scoring against Brentford brings the best from his shooting prowess with both feet. His October halfway line strike against Crystal Palace came with his right foot. As with a number of Brighton’s purchases, Gómez can play in other positions, variously defensive midfielder, attacking midfielder, even on the wing. Within Fabian Hürzeler’s stringent tactical setup, he is asked to work hard for the ball. Such high pressing created the opportunity Charalampos Kostoulas should have done better with in the moments after the opening goal. John Brewin
Match report: Brighton 2-0 Brentford

There is nothing wrong with Arsenal’s habit of winning games by a single goal: Mikel Arteta’s side did it 15 times on their way to the title last season and the latest against Hull was their fourth this season. Yet despite being six points clear of Manchester City heading into the international break, Arteta will have some concerns about the lack of goals so far. With only 15 from their first 10 matches, Arsenal are on course to break Manchester United’s record of 67 for the fewest by a team being crowned champions in 1993 – the Premier League’s first season. They have also been struggling to score in the first half of games, having gone six matches in all competitions without doing so last month, and Arteta has called on his players to be more ruthless. “Sometimes we try to score the perfect goal against low blocks, but we need to be much more chaotic than that. If we open the scoring much earlier also, it changes the game,” he said. Ed Aarons
Match report: Arsenal 1-0 Hull

All hail Brian Brobbey. It is fascinating that a player sometimes derided for his supposed lack of technical quality while at Ajax has developed into one of the Premier League’s most potent and difficult-to-play centre-forwards in little more than a year in England. His new contract, announced last Wednesday, is richly deserved. There is, as Régis Le Bris acknowledged after the win over Chelsea in which he bullied the visitors, no one quite like him. “Against a team that wants to press like that it’s so important to have a target man,” said the Sunderland manager, and Brobbey was that and then some. Much has been made of how Chelsea miss João Pedro but the Mackems are a different team with their flying Dutchman. Andy Brassell
Match report: Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea

It was a tale of two benches at Elland Road. The big question hanging over Leeds is whether they have the support for Dominic Calvert-Lewin to make a concerted push for Europe this season; a question that went some way to being answered when the substitutes Harry Wilson and Noah Okafor combined for the latter to score the winner against Tottenham. In contrast, Roberto De Zerbi’s attacking options let him down in a game that felt there for the taking. Dominic Solanke struggled after replacing Mathys Tel, Omar Marmoush looked limited in the central striker role and their brightest performer was the 18-year-old Lucá Williams-Barnett, who, you would suspect, is now not far from a deserved start. Having won three straight games before their defeat in West Yorkshire, Spurs suddenly go into the international break with more questions than answers over their attacking credentials once again. Aaron Bower

Andoni Iraola had one wish as he signed off for the international window with the 3-1 win at Crystal Palace – that he does not lose any players to injury before Liverpool are back in action against Manchester United at Anfield on Sunday week. The manager is scarred by the previous round of international fixtures: Dominik Szoboszlai, Cody Gakpo and Alexander Isak all picked up problems. The trio were missed as Liverpool lost to Manchester City in the first game back. Szoboszlai’s injury was the most concerning: he was only able to return as a substitute in the defeat against Arsenal on 1 November and Iraola said after the win at Palace that the Hungary midfielder was not 100%, that a knee problem required management. “Let’s see if Dom can play with the national team or not,” Iraola said. “I know what I want! But I have to understand the national teams. Also I’m sure Dom will want to go. I’m not sure if it’s going to be fine.” David Hytner
Match report: Crystal Palace 1-3 Liverpool

Bournemouth are really getting to grips with the Thursday-Sunday grind in their first season in Europe. Marco Rose has been working hard to ensure his team are in the right shape to start Premier League games quickly after a Europa League assignment three days earlier. After Thursday’s trip to face Sparta Prague, Bournemouth were quick out of the traps at Ipswich on Sunday, taking the lead through Evanilson after five minutes. “Last week [against Leeds] I said we start slow and this week we start quite quick and score an early goal – I am a magician,” said the head coach, after their eighth consecutive win in all competitions. That equalled a club record set under Eddie Howe in League One. Evanilson is himself on a streak – he’s scored in five in a row in the league – and only Nicolas Jackson has scored as many in the top flight since the last international break. The Brazilian did not need Christian Walton’s helping hand with this goal. BM
Match report: Ipswich 1-2 Bournemouth

Newcastle delivered one of their more convincing performances of the season at Fulham, but one area remains a headache for Matthias Jaissle. Efforts to replace Alexander Isak in attack have not been good enough. Nick Woltemade was loaned to Juventus after an inconsistent debut season in England and there was not much encouragement to take from how Yoane Wissa and William Osula played at Craven Cottage. Wissa, who has struggled since his £55m move from Brentford last summer, has four goals in 41 appearances and did not put himself about enough before being taken off after 61 minutes, while Osula did not manage a touch in Fulham’s area and lost possession before Rodrigo Muniz’s late equaliser for the hosts. Jaissle needs more from his forwards on and off the ball. Otherwise Newcastle are going to need to find different players to lead their attack. Jacob Steinberg
Match report: Fulham 1-1 Newcastle

The laws on hair-pulling were changed for this season after the red cards that were issued to Michael Keane, Lisandro Martínez and Dan Ballard in 2025-26. They are undoubtedly an improvement but, as James Tarkowski’s pull on Caleb Yirenkyi’s hair demonstrated in Everton’s comeback against Coventry, grey areas remain. Frank Lampard and David Moyes agreed the Everton captain should not have been sent off as there was no excessive force involved. But was it “a clear action without excessive force” that should have resulted in a yellow card for unsporting behaviour and a penalty to Coventry? Or “negligible, accidental or inadvertent contact” that is not usually considered an offence? Moyes offered up one solution – scrap the law altogether. “I think it is still ridiculous that is even categorised in the rules of the game,” the Everton manager said. “I can’t understand why they don’t fix this completely because I don’t see it as a good rule at all.” Andy Hunter
Match report: Everton 3-1 Coventry

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳一球小胜赫尔城领跑英超，但进球效率引发阿尔特塔关注。
bodyZh: 奥利弗·格拉斯纳对利亚姆·德拉普失去耐心原本是非常容易的事情。这位前锋年仅23岁，但他此前在伊普斯维奇单赛季攻入12球的辉煌时期似乎已经过去很久（他在曼城的六场比赛则更加遥远）。在切尔西的一个赛季让他丧失了信心，展现出一种既自信不足又过度激进的矛盾混合体，在禁区内毫无冷静可言，双臂挥舞得像个破风车。但昔日的天赋并未抛弃他。周六的两粒进球都是强力冲击的结果，如果说第一脚射门本质上是以最大力量将球打向目标，那么第二记则是精确且极具力量的远角破门。经历这样的比赛后，人们完全可以想象他成为英格兰队哈里·凯恩的长期替代者。乔纳森·威尔逊
比赛报告：诺丁汉森林 3-1 曼城

在老特拉福德混乱的比赛中，有一场表现格外耀眼。阿利森在阿斯顿维拉的英超生涯中此前只有过一个进球，但在对阵曼联的前48分钟里，他不仅打进一球还助攻两次。这位20岁的边锋此前仅代表巴西U16国家队出场，去年1月以870万英镑的初始转会费从格雷米奥加盟。他在过去的18次出场中唯一的进球是在9月对阵诺丁汉森林时打进的——此役开场不到一分钟他就攻破了曼联球门，不到四分钟他的射门被扑出后又助攻尼古拉斯·杰克逊打进维拉的第二球。曼联右后卫迪奥戈·达洛特在丢球时回防太慢，而在下半场初段因放倒这名巴西球员送出点球时也无话可说。达洛特常常是曼联困境的缩影，他在下半场被换下时遭到嘘声，而阿利森则在客队球迷的掌声中离场。比利·芒迪
比赛报告：曼联 4-4 阿斯顿维拉

迭戈·戈麦斯是布赖顿又一个低调起步、在获得时间和空间适应后最终大放异彩的例子。他目前的形象仿佛是一夜成名，但自2025年11月对阵利兹联独中两元以来，他对精彩进球的追求和门前感觉就显而易见。戈麦斯是当年1月从迈阿密国际加盟的。他在右肋部用左脚内侧兜射攻破布伦特福德球门的位置，最能展现他双脚出众的射门能力。去年10月对阵水晶宫时他在中圈附近的吊射则是用右脚完成的。就像布赖顿的许多引援一样，戈麦斯能够胜任多个位置，包括防守型中场、进攻型中场甚至边锋。在法比安·许策尔严苛的战术体系中，他被要求积极拼抢球权。正是这种高位逼抢为查拉兰波斯·科斯图拉斯在首开纪录后创造了本应把握得更好的机会。约翰·布鲁因
比赛报告：布赖顿 2-0 布伦特福德

阿森纳习惯于以一球优势赢得比赛并没有错：米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在上赛季夺冠历程中有15次做到这一点，而最近对阵赫尔城的胜利是他们本赛季的第四场。然而，尽管在进入国际比赛日时领先曼城6分，阿尔特塔对目前的进球乏力仍有一些担忧。在前10场比赛中仅打入15球的阿森纳，正朝着打破曼联在1993年（英超首个赛季）创下的夺冠球队最少进球纪录（67球）的方向发展。他们在比赛上半场也一直难以取得进球，上个月曾在各项赛事中连续六场比赛在上半场颗粒无收，阿尔特塔已呼吁球员们在门前更加冷酷无情。“有时我们试图在密集防守面前打进完美的进球，但我们需要比那更加混乱。如果我们能更早打破僵局，比赛形势也会随之改变，”他说。埃德·阿伦斯
比赛报告：阿森纳 1-0 赫尔城

向布莱恩·布罗贝伊致敬。令人着迷的是，这位在效力阿贾克斯时曾因所谓的缺乏技术能力而饱受嘲讽的球员，在登陆英格兰一年多后，已经成长为英超最具威力和最难以防守的中锋之一。他于上周三宣布续约，这是他应得的。正如雷吉斯·勒布里斯在击败切尔西并压制住对手后所承认的那样，没有人能像他一样。“面对一支想要这样进行高位逼抢的球队，拥有一名柱式中锋是如此重要，”这位桑德兰主帅说道，而布罗贝伊不仅做到了这一点，还做得更多。人们对切尔西缺少若昂·佩德罗议论纷纷，但缺少了这位荷兰飞翼的桑德兰将是另一支球队。安迪·布拉塞尔
比赛报告：桑德兰 1-0 切尔西

这是埃兰路球场两队替补席形成鲜明对比的故事。悬在利兹头上最大的问题是，他们是否有足够的阵容厚度支持多米尼克·卡尔弗特-勒温在本赛季向欧战发起全力冲击；当替补登场的哈里·威尔逊和诺亚·奥卡福连线并由后者攻入绝杀热刺的进球时，这个问题在一定程度上得到了解答。相比之下，罗伯托·德泽尔比的进攻选择在比赛中让人失望。多米尼克·索兰克在替换马蒂斯·特尔后举步维艰，奥马尔·马尔穆什在中锋位置上显得办法不多，而他们表现最亮眼的球员是18岁的卢卡·威廉姆斯-巴内特，你可能会觉得他现在距离获得首发机会已经不远了。在西约克郡失利之前取得三连胜的热刺，在进入国际比赛日之际，其进攻资质再次引发了更多疑问而非答案。阿伦·鲍尔

比赛报告：利兹 1-0 热刺

安东尼·伊劳拉带着在水晶宫客场3-1取胜的战绩进入国际比赛日，他只有一个愿望——希望在下周日利物浦前往安菲尔德对阵曼联之前，不要有任何球员在国家队比赛中受伤。这位主帅对上一轮国际比赛日心有余悸：多米尼克·索博斯洛伊、科迪·加克波和亚历山大·伊萨克都遇到了伤病问题。利物浦在回归后的首场比赛中输给曼城时，非常想念这三人。索博斯洛伊的伤情最令人担忧：直到11月1日输给阿森纳的比赛中他才作为替补复出，伊劳拉在客胜水晶宫后表示这位匈牙利中场并未完全恢复100%，膝盖问题需要管理。“让我们看看多姆是否能为国家队出场吧，”伊劳拉说。“我知道我想要什么！但我必须理解国家队。而且我也确信多姆会想要去。我不确定这一切是否会顺利。”大卫·海特纳
比赛报告：水晶宫 1-3 利物浦

伯恩茅斯在参加欧战的首个赛季中，正逐渐适应周四与周日连轴转的赛程。马可·罗斯一直在努力确保球队在三天前参加完欧联杯任务后，能够以正确的体能状态迅速进入英超比赛的节奏。在周四前往客场面对布拉格斯巴达后，伯恩茅斯周日在伊普斯维奇迅速进入状态，并在第5分钟由埃凡尼尔松取得领先。“上周（对阵利兹时）我说我们开局慢，而这周我们开局相当快并打进了一个早早的进球——我简直是个魔术师，”这位主教练在球队取得各项赛事八连胜后说道。这追平了埃迪·豪在英甲时期创下的俱乐部纪录。埃凡尼尔松本人也处于连场进球的势头中——他在联赛中已经连续五场破门，自上一个国际比赛日以来，只有尼古拉斯·杰克逊在顶级联赛中的进球数能与他媲美。这位巴西人的进球并没有借助克里斯蒂安·沃尔顿的帮助。BM
比赛报告：伊普斯维奇 1-2 伯恩茅斯

纽卡斯尔联队在富勒姆踢出了本赛季最具说服力的表现之一，但有一个区域仍然让马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯尔头疼。寻找亚历山大·伊萨克替代者的努力还远远不够。尼克·沃尔特马德在经历了英格兰的首个起伏不定的赛季后被租借至尤文图斯，而约安·维萨和威廉·奥苏拉在克拉文农场的表现也并没有带来多少鼓舞。维萨自从去年夏天以5500万英镑从布伦特福德转会以来一直举步维艰，在41次出场中仅攻入4球，在第61分钟被换下之前也没有发挥足够的作用，而奥苏拉在富勒姆禁区内甚至没有完成一次触球，并在主队由罗德里戈·穆尼斯打入绝平球之前丢掉了球权。贾伊斯尔需要他的前锋在进攻和防守时都发挥更大作用。否则，纽卡斯尔将不得不寻找其他球员来引领他们的进攻。雅各布·斯坦伯格
比赛报告：富勒姆 1-1 纽卡斯尔联

拉扯头发的规则在本赛季进行了更改，此前迈克尔·基恩、利桑德罗·马丁内斯和丹·巴拉德在2025-26赛季都曾因此吃到红牌。这些改变无疑是一种进步，但正如詹姆斯·塔科夫斯基在埃尔文·基伦基的头发上拉扯所表明的那样，埃尔文对阵考文垂的逆转比赛中灰色地带依然存在。弗兰克·兰帕德和大卫·莫耶斯一致认为这位埃尔文队长不应该被罚下，因为其中并不包含过度用力。但这究竟是应该因非体育行为吃到黄牌并判给考文垂点球的“没有过度力气的清晰动作”？还是通常不被视为犯规的“微不足道、意外或无意的接触”？莫耶斯给出了一个解决方案——彻底废除这条规则。“我认为将其列入比赛规则依然荒谬，”这位埃尔文主帅说道，“我无法理解他们为什么不彻底解决这个问题，因为我根本不认为这是一条好规则。”安东尼·亨特
比赛报告：埃弗顿 3-1 考文垂

bodyEn: As most Arsenal supporters would testify, patience is a virtue. They needed plenty during the 22-year wait to be crowned Premier League champions and Mikel Arteta’s side certainly had to retain their composure as they tried to break down a dogged Hull side. They had not beaten Arsenal in 14 attempts since winning on their first visit to this ground in 2008. But with 20 minutes to play, there was still every chance that Sergej Jakirovic’s team could have pulled off one of the shocks of the season.

Arsenal had already been denied a penalty just before half-time for a shirt pull on Kai Havertz in the box a week after escaping the same crime against Liverpool at Anfield, in a moment of controversy that could have been the major talking point from this match. Martin Ødegaard had other ideas and the Arsenal captain’s fifth goal of the season was enough to ensure they will go into the international break with a healthy lead over Manchester City. Enzo Maresca’s side are up next here in the league after the international break, with Arsenal having matched their record tally of 27 points from their opening 10 games. The signs look ominous for the rest, even if they were made to work for the points throughout by their opponents.

“To the international break after winning is one of the best things for a coach,” said Arteta. “I need to praise the players and all the staff for the work that they are doing because it’s been very, very demanding. We have a very short time to recover from games but despite that the mentality and the quality of the team has shown: it’s incredible.”

Jakirovic had promised beforehand that his side would go on the front foot. “If you are passive, they will destroy you,” said the Bosnian. But while his bold 5-3-2 formation caused Arsenal’s much-vaunted defence some issues, Hull remain without a league victory since the end of August. “It’s a big experience for us,” was Jakirovic’s post-match assessment. “We can take some big lessons from this but we have shown we can compete at this level.”

Hull made the brighter start as John Egan headed wide from a corner. After losing to Brighton before the last international break, Arteta was taking no chances and reverted to the side that won at Liverpool last weekend. There was no William Saliba on the bench, with the France defender set to play for the under-21s on Sunday instead as he continues his comeback from a back injury.
